prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Sign-in reordering (sign_in, reorder) tends to have a negative impact, as 2 tests agree after noise correction.
No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no tests resulted in a statistically significant win.
Evidence is still thin for home flow changes (home, new_flow), path redesigns (choose_path, redesign), and adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) because each has only 1 test so far.
No clear effect was seen for new home flows, path selection redesigns, or photo upload split layout redesigns.
Predictions were consistently too high and overly optimistic, particularly for sign-in reordering where a +20.0% gain was predicted but resulted in a loss.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: +0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +2.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -2.1% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Orientation Screen: Add a new screen called new_desktop_orientation right after home_intro explaining desktop spawn location and basic interaction shortcuts. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple tickets regarding pets missing on desktop or confusion on how to talk to/control the pet.)
1: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Interactive Mascot Mini Flow: Transform the waiting screen into an interactive companion preview flow with play actions while generation finishes. (why: The waiting step has a very long mean duration (2336s), causing drop-off; engaging interactions keep users active during generation.)
2: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Recovery Hint: Display a helpful hint on the sign-in screen informing users how account login preserves and syncs pet data across installs. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again, while sign_in loses 27.1% of users.)
3: [adoption, wait_info] Upload Photos Progress Time Estimate: Enable estimated time display and helpful creation tips during photo processing on the upload_photos screen. (why: Support receives tickets about custom pet generation stalling/failing, and adoption step drops 39.1% of users.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Story Screen Onboarding Expectation Headline: Update the story screen headline and body text to set quick setup expectations before choosing a path. (why: Initial entry drop-off is high (76.2% conversion on choose_path step); establishing low effort upfront boosts progression.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen System Notification Toggle: Enable notify_when_ready on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app while their pet finishes generating. (why: The median waiting time is 201s with a mean of 2336s, suggesting users walk away and abandon the window.)

scores.note: Strong support evidence for finish drop-off (35.2% loss), but requires creating a new screen.
High development effort for interactive flow; home new_flow tests historically show minimal lift.
Low cost text hint backed by 8 support tickets and 27.1% sign-in drop-off.
Targets largest funnel drop-off step (39.1% loss) with support ticket backing via simple config toggle.
Simple copy change to set expectations on entry; funnel evidence only without support tickets.
Config toggle addressing long home wait duration (mean 2336s) by allowing notification on completion.
